summary.formula: ranking_score = confluence_weighted (0-100) + confidence_100*0.30 + grade_bonus(A+25/A20/B15/C10/D5) + dominant_prob*0.20 ; tie-breaker: internal_symbol ASC, audit_id ASC. Eligibility: status==REAL_SIGNAL AND decision in (BUY,SELL) AND trade_allowed==true AND prob_sum_ok==true AND confidence not None AND confluence not None
